cohort: 316 neonates admitted to the NICU of Children's University Hospital, Assiut University, Egypt, with a mean gestational age of 34 +/- 4 weeks and a mean birth weight of 2.03 +/- 0.85 kg
finding: Drug-related problems (DRPs) were common (89.6% of neonates experienced at least one DRP), with a mean of 5.5 DRPs per patient, and the majority were related to treatment effectiveness and dose selection; pharmacist interventions were highly accepted (98.8%) and effective (92% DRP resolution).
followup_time: August to November 2023 (duration of the study)
